algorithm: demonstration-assisted TD-MPC2 V3 port; not original-paper reproduction
teacher: Meta-World3.1.1 SawyerPickPlaceV3Policy, actions clipped to [-1,1], frozen scripted expert
normalization: fixed 40000 pre-action teacher training states; std floor0.001, elapsed time unchanged
replay: same demo-assisted loss and half initial/half completed-online replay as HAB; actor batch half successful teacher/half student correction after correction collection
reward: unaltered native Meta-World reward, no clipping or rescaling
time_limit: finite500; early success does not terminate; TD and MPC exclude value after500
development: 20 fixed novel reset seeds, direct-policy/MPC paired; all checkpoints retained
final_test: 20 additional reset seeds evaluated only at fixed100000 checkpoint; not a full MT1 or MT50 benchmark
notes: HAB run is preserved. New weights are initialized for 40D/4D Meta-World; no HAB checkpoint loading. One training seed, pilot budget smaller than original paper. Scripted expert is not a trained world model.
